proposed_fix.description: Confirm packet loss on the recommendationservice pod/node path, then mitigate by moving the pod or restarting it only after human approval.
steps: Check network receive/transmit errors and drops on the node hosting recommendationservice and on the pod's interface (read-only) to confirm loss.
Check recommendationservice pod events, restarts, and socket/connection state (read-only) to understand the socket z=86.98 and mem z=41.08 deviations.
If loss is confined to one node, cordon that node (reversible) and reschedule the recommendationservice pod to a healthy node after approval.
If loss is not node-local, inspect network policy/firewall rules and recent changes affecting recommendationservice traffic and revert any recent change under approval.
Watch recommendationservice latency-50/90, inbound call error rate, and frontend latency-90 for recovery after each action.
preconditions: Node or pod network error/drop counters confirm loss affecting recommendationservice.
Other replicas or nodes have spare capacity to receive the rescheduled pod.
On-call has approved each state-changing action (cordon, reschedule, rule revert).
Recent deploy/config changes to recommendationservice or the network have been reviewed.
proposed_fix.rollback: Uncordon the node, scale or reschedule the pod back if needed, and restore any reverted network rules or config from their saved prior versions.
